summary: The root كهل (khl) refers to the upper back or shoulder area. It can mean the withers of an animal, the part of the back near the neck, or the area between the shoulder blades.
lane: كَاهِلٌ ذ [The withers of a horse, &c.] i. q. حَارِكٌ : or the anterior portion of the upper part of the back, next the neck, which is the upper third part, containing six vertebra: or the part between the two shoulder-blades: or the part where the neck is joined to the back how: [the base of the neck: see ثَبَجٌ ]. (K.)
